verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded Payroll is a first-party partner platform for building payroll into your own product. It offers pre-built UI flows or custom builds on the APIs, a customizable React SDK, and official client libraries. System access tokens let partners create partner-managed companies, and the payroll surface covers regular and off-cycle runs, taxes, contractors and webhooks. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of white-label branding or theming controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration from partner developers.
